body: MEASURED DESIGN CORRECTION during implementation: the proposed opaque fields close apply and copy but do NOT close generated case-class fromProduct. External-package probes compile ProviderCall.fromProduct with raw Some(blank), and CriticFinding.fromProduct with raw Some(blank); focused runs fail exactly those two unconstructibility courts (core 26/27, acquire 8/9). Scala generated fromProduct accepts Product without element-level static validation, and the opaque values erase to String. Therefore both containing public types must become private-constructor non-case classes, matching the existing ClaimMeta and PromptPackageManifest boundary, while retaining semantic opaque fields, validated factories, explicit checked rebuild methods, structural equals/hashCode, and public reads. I am proceeding on the chief-required unconstructibility outcome; this supersedes the ADR sentence that case classes may remain. Mandatory independent review remains with new-engineer.
